Man-Up Order picker (HLO) - 4782 SC Moerdijk, 4782 SC Moerdijk - 
 €14.99 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour 
Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? 
The job is done with a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is big enough, so the worker has space to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters. The worker goes up together with the cabin. Before going up, the worker puts an empty pallet on the forks. Sometimes there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. 
When you are is high in the air, you takes boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse. 
 Job Requirements 
 - HLO (Man Up) certificate or willing to get it - Not afraid to work in height - Physicaly ready to work - English speaking - Detailed orientated 
 Employment conditions

The Company has built a technological lead specialising in design, development, lease and operation of tanker-based production and storage systems, and has become a leading provider of innovative Single Point Mooring systems. 
As the Materials Expeditor, you play a key role in ensuring timely and efficient delivery of materials, services and related documentation across all phases of procurement. You will coordinate closely with suppliers, monitor progress, resolve issues, and maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders. Your proactive approach helps safeguard project timelines and quality standards, while your attention to detail ensures compliance with corporate procedures and continuous improvement of our procurement processes. 
Furthermore, you: - Expedite material as required per the Purchase Order (PO) in order to meet contractual agreed delivery dates. - Ensure timely receipt and follow-up of supplier documentation and correspondence as agreed per the Project Document Requirement List (PDRL) and Instructions to Suppliers. - Verify actuals against planning. - Notify changes and problems in PO execution and liaise with stakeholders on solutions. - Develop, maintain and distribute the Expediting Status Report (ESR) to report performance of vendors. - Instruct and follow-up transports with suppliers and forwarders based on Inspection Release Notes or Shipping Release Notes. - Administrate vendor correspondence. - Reports regularly to the Procurement department.
